oneSentenceConcept: The hero reads as a living catalog index — typographic hierarchy staged in chapters — so the portfolio feels like one trustworthy continuum instead of a gallery of effects.
heroConcept: Overscaled stacked-type index headline with subtle chapter markers that resolve on scroll; cool catalog field and a single lucid teal continuum rule that extends on entry. Experimental only in the hero band.
emergingSignals: Unified trust systems where content, visuals, and interaction act as one
Chaptered scroll storytelling with practical destinations intact
Brand atmosphere felt before feature explanation
AI as compositional material rather than chat chrome
visualLanguage: Cool catalog paper with deep ink hierarchy and one lucid teal accent channel — restrained surfaces so typographic index and continuum cues carry the art direction.
interactionLanguage: Chapter-resolve scroll in the hero; depth-reveal hover on affordances; navigation stays structurally stable with minimal continuum underline.
motionLanguage: Subtle continuum pacing — accent rule extension on entry, chapter markers easing into place on scroll. No snap-sections; instant hierarchy under prefers-reduced-motion.
storytellingApproach: Hero as indexed prologue; supporting sections continue as quieter catalog bands in linear calm — never competing chapter systems below the fold.
creativeTechnologyIdeas: CSS scroll-driven animation for hero chapter-marker resolve
View Transitions API crossfade to preserve place between routes
Token-driven continuum accent via theme and interaction-system JSON
typographyDirection: Bold sans display as catalog index scale in the hero; highly legible minimal body rhythm elsewhere — no serif magazine editorial.
compositionDirection: Stacked-type hero with deliberate vertical chapter rhythm; supporting sections use muted catalog bands and comfortable grid spacing.
colorDirection: Cool gray-green paper field, near-black green ink type, single deep teal accent for continuum emphasis only.
textureDirection: Flat catalog fills and fine border weight — no grain stacks, glassmorphism, or decorative gradient meshes.
supportingPageTreatment: Quieter bordered cards on muted section bands; accent reserved for interactive affordances and a stable continuum underline in navigation.
avoid: Full WebGL arcade or advergame heroes
Playful jiggly CTA and ear-popping novelty stacks
Warm cream editorial palettes with serif magazine display
